name: Electronegativity Difference
description: Compute the electronegativity difference |χA - χB| between two bonded atoms using Pauling scale values. This single number classifies bond character: <0.4 = covalent, 0.4–1.7 = polar covalent, >1.7 = ionic. CHEM_ELECTRONEGATIVITY looks up each atom's Pauling χ from the preloaded constant table; MIF_SUB + MIF_ABS gives the unsigned difference. Operates on element pairs — wire multiple instances in parallel for a full molecule's bond characterisation.
author: system
